slides.texte_overlay:
5 beautiful words most
people have never heard

lambent

softly glowing or flickering.

"the lambent light
of the candles."

apricity

the warmth of the sun
in winter.

"we sat in the apricity
of a january afternoon."

susurrus

a soft whispering or
rustling sound.

"the susurrus of the leaves."

sempiternal

eternal and unchanging.

"the sempiternal beauty
of the sea."

limerence

the dreamy, obsessive feeling
of a new crush.

which one is your favourite?
